verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a software product that ships a Partner API, an Embedded SDK and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public repository, published source code or an open license for any doola component. The probes only show public docs, llms.txt and a documented MCP server, none of which amounts to readable source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
